experiences.name: Prague Castle Complex Tour
experiences.description: Explore the largest ancient castle complex in the world, including St. Vitus Cathedral, the Old Royal Palace, and Golden Lane. Walk through centuries of Bohemian history with stunning panoramic views over Prague's red rooftops.

experiences.name: Budapest Thermal Bath Experience
experiences.description: Soak in the iconic Széchenyi or Gellért thermal baths, a centuries-old Hungarian tradition built on natural geothermal springs. Marvel at the stunning Neo-Baroque architecture while relaxing in mineral-rich waters used since the Ottoman era.

experiences.name: Prague Old Town & Astronomical Clock Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the medieval Old Town Square, witness the famous 15th-century Orloj Astronomical Clock chime on the hour, and explore Gothic churches, Baroque palaces, and the historic Jewish Quarter (Josefov) with a local guide.

experiences.name: Budapest Danube River Evening Cruise
experiences.description: Sail along the Danube at sunset and after dark to witness the illuminated Hungarian Parliament Building, Buda Castle, and Chain Bridge — a UNESCO World Heritage panorama. Includes commentary on the city's rich Austro-Hungarian history.

experiences.name: Budapest Ruin Bar Crawl & Local Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Discover Budapest's legendary ruin bars — eclectic bars built inside abandoned Jewish Quarter buildings — while sampling Hungarian street food like lángos (fried dough), kürtőskalács (chimney cake), and local craft beers. A perfect blend of nightlife culture and culinary history.
